title: Pin Before Awaiting Reference
goal: Pin a non-Unpin future before taking a mutable reference to await it.
hints: Delay contains PhantomPinned so it is !Unpin, which prevents awaiting Box<Delay>.
Use `Box::pin(fut)` to heap-allocate and pin the future inside Pin<Box<Delay>>.
explanation: `Box::pin(fut)` moves the future to the heap and pins it there, which is what a `!Unpin` future needs before it can be awaited through a variable. `Box::new(fut)` only heap-allocates: `Box<F>` is a `Future` only when `F` is `Unpin`, and `PhantomPinned` makes this one not. `Pin::new` is for types that are already `Unpin`, so it is rejected with `E0277` for the same reason.
